thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty trigger: service=redis-gpu-inference-prod, severity=critical. Alert: GPU memory pressure on cluster 'infer-gpu-06' - 2/4 GPUs above 95% memory, recent OOMs detected. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/incident/PI-12345>

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PI-12345 created and paged rotation. Trigger reason: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY / CUDAMalloc failed.

Maya: ack - I'm on it. Swapping to incident channel. Can someone post a short impact summary?

Lee: Seeing repeated `CUDAMalloc failed` in node infer-gpu-06 logs. Worker pids 4123, 4139 crashed. Autoscaler didn't add nodes yet.

Jordan: Impact: ~12% of requests to model 'rwkv-13b-med' are failing with 503-oom. Latency spikes observed for batched streams.

Maya: Thanks. Triage plan: 1) Pause heavy offline eval jobs; 2) Evict long-running KV cache sessions; 3) Scale up pool by +2 GPUs or route traffic to fallback model. I'll start 2 & 1.

Sam: Re: pause evals - issuing API call to job-runner: `POST /jobs/pause?tag=eval-heavy` -> done. Confirmed jobs paused.

Tanvi: KVCACHE eviction script running: `kubectl exec -it kvcache-ctrl -- python evict.py --threshold 0.75 --drop-sessions 30m` -> started.

Maya: Routing change: enabling fallback routing policy to send new traffic to `rwkv-13b-quant` (lower mem). Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy fallback-quant --selector model=rwkv-13b
```
Applied.

Lee: Node infer-gpu-06 shows GPU 0/1 memory leaking even after worker killed. Kernel logs show `cuda: Unaccounted memory` from process 4123. Suggest reimaging node if memory not freed.

Jordan: Can we drain node? That will impact throughput but reduce OOM risk.

Maya: Draining infer-gpu-06 now: `kubectl drain infer-gpu-06 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> start. Moving pods.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by Maya.

oncall-bot: Auto-shedder triggered on pool 'rwkv-prod': dropping smallest batch sizes and lowering max_batch to 8 -> reduced instantaneous footprint.

Sam: Observability shows memory pressure down from 96% -> 82% after routing + eviction + shedder.

Tanvi: Some clients still hit 503s for in-flight sessions. Temporarily enabling CPU fallback for long-running requests: `policy add fallback:cpu-timeout=60s`.

Lee: I inspected crash logs - model runtime had a stuck CUDA stream; kernel shows `last error: out of memory`. We should reboot the GPU driver on infer-gpu-06 if drain doesn't free memory.

Maya: Let's wait for drain to finish (eta ~2m). If not freed, I'll coordinate a driver restart with infra.

Jordan: Customer impact note: CS reported one paying customer experienced degraded responses for 11 minutes. We'll need to add to incident summary.

Maya: Drain completed. Memory freed on infer-gpu-06. No driver restart required. Re-scheduling pods now. Monitoring.

Sam: Error rate for rwkv model back down to baseline. Latency 95th reduced from 1.4s->0.6s.

Maya: Great. Next actions: 1) keep shedder policy active for 30m; 2) add preemptive kvcache eviction for pools with >70% mem; 3) follow up ticket to investigate process-level leak in runtime v2.3.4. I'll create the follow-up.

Maya: @jordan @lee @sam please add notes to PI-12345: cause suspected CUDA allocation leak in model runtime; mitigations: routing fallback, kvcache eviction, drain node, auto-shedder.

Jordan: Added notes to PD incident.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PI-12345 status changed: triaged -> monitoring. Escalation stopped.

Maya: Handoff to night oncall @tanvi in 20m. If anything flares, page with 'GPU OOM' and include link to PD. /cc @infra-eng

Tanvi: I'll take handoff. Good runbook updates? Maya: I'll attach runbook snippet to the PD.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by Maya. Final remark: root cause investigation ticket RW-456 opened.
